claims.claim_text: In fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, 98% of SAIC's total revenues were attributable to prime contracts with the U.S. government or to subcontracts with other contractors engaged in work for the U.S. government.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: In fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, 98% of our total revenues were attributable to prime contracts with the U.S. government or to subcontracts with other contractors engaged in work for the U.S. government.

claims.claim_text: In fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, approximately 52% of SAIC's total revenues were attributable to the Department of War (formerly DoD).
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: In fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, approximately 52% of our total revenues were attributable to the "Department of War", while 46% were attributable to "Intelligence and other federal government agencies"

claims.claim_text: SAIC's Defense and Intelligence segment provides a diverse portfolio of national security solutions to the DoW and the Intelligence Community, with offerings including IT modernization, digital engineering, AI, mission systems support, training and simulation, and ground vehicles support.
claims.subject: SAIC Defense and Intelligence segment
claims.object_value: IT mod / digital eng / AI / mission systems / training-sim / ground vehicles
claims.source_quote: The Defense and Intelligence segment provides a diverse portfolio of national security solutions to the DoW and the Intelligence Community... including IT modernization, digital engineering, artificial intelligence ("AI"), mission systems support and advisory, training and simulation, and ground vehicles support.

claims.claim_text: SAIC integrates, modifies, upgrades, and sustains ground vehicles for U.S. armed forces (Mission Systems Support / Ground Vehicles Support offering).
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: Ground Vehicles Support: We integrate, modify, upgrade, and sustain ground vehicles for our nation's armed forces, leveraging commercial products and in-house solutions to address some of the toughest challenges facing warfighters.

claims.claim_text: Next Generation Space: SAIC integrates advanced solutions to enable the rapid deployment of future space missions.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: Next Generation Space: We integrate advanced solutions to enable the rapid deployment of future space missions.

claims.claim_text: SAIC believes spending packages such as the infrastructure bill, Inflation Reduction Act, and CHIPS and Science Act may provide additional opportunity in areas of focus such as digital modernization, cyber, microelectronics support, and climate resiliency.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: Spending packages, including the infrastructure bill, Inflation Reduction Act, and CHIPS and Science Act, as well as future potential spending packages, may provide additional opportunity in areas of SAIC focus such as digital modernization, cyber, microelectronics support, and climate resiliency.

claims.claim_text: On October 15, 2025, SAIC acquired SilverEdge Government Solutions, an innovative provider of mission-driven technology solutions and products; the acquisition advances SAIC's strategy to provide mission focused solutions and commercial products.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: On October 15, 2025, we acquired SilverEdge Government Solutions, an innovative provider of mission-driven technology solutions and products.

claims.claim_text: SAIC serves customers through approximately 1,700 active contracts and task orders and employs approximately 23,000 individuals.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: We serve our customers through approximately 1,700 active contracts and task orders. We have approximately 23,000 employees...

claims.claim_text: SAIC occupies approximately 3 million square feet of floor space, substantially all of which is leased.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: We occupy approximately 3 million square feet of floor space, substantially all of which is leased.

claims.claim_text: Effective January 31, 2026, SAIC completed a business reorganization that consolidated its five business groups into three; this is the second reorganization since fiscal 2025.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: Effective January 31, 2026, the first day of fiscal 2027, we completed a business reorganization that consolidated our five business groups into three.
